mal:area.comment:
The Platform set of services contains services for monitoring and control of devices on-board of a spacecraft platform. The following services are contained in the Platform services set: The Camera service allows a consumer to take and stream pictures. The GNSS service allows a consumer to retrieve satellite navigation data. The Autonomous ADCS service allows a consumer to determine the attitude, and additionally to control the attitude by selecting the desired definition. The Software-defined Radio service allows a consumer to configure and receive a stream of data from a Software-defined Radio. The Optical Data Receiver service allows a consumer to stream data from the Optical Data Receiver. The Power Control service allows a consumer to control the power of the different subsystems.
This section details the Platform services. The area and structures are defined in terms of the MO Message Abstraction Layer (MAL), so it is possible to deploy them over any supported protocol and message transport.
mal:area.name: Platform

mal:service.name: Camera
mal:service.comment: The Camera service allows a consumer to acquire pictures and control a camera in the spacecraft platform. The service can perform format conversions in case the consumer selects a specific format other than raw. The service can also stream pictures periodically.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The Camera service shall provide:
  1. the capability for streaming pictures;
  2. the capability for previewing pictures;
  3. the capability for taking pictures;
  4. the capability for requesting the service and camera properties.

mal:pubsubIP.name: picturesStream
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The picturesStream operation allows a consumer to subscribe for pictures published after enableStream call.
mal:pubsubIP.mal:documentation: The timestamp of the update shall be the time of when the picture was taken.

mal:field.name: tag
mal:field.comment: The value provided by the consumer during the enableStream operation.

mal:field.name: objId
mal:field.comment: A unique object instance identifier.

mal:field.name: width
mal:field.comment: The width value of the resolution object.

mal:field.name: height
mal:field.comment: The height value of the resolution object.

mal:field.name: picture
mal:field.comment: The picture in streaming mode.

mal:submitIP.name: enableStream
mal:submitIP.comment: The enableStream operation allows a consumer to set the rate, dimension and format of the Pictures being streamed.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: If the enable field is TRUE, then the tag field shall not be NULL, empty, nor the wildcard '*'.

mal:field.name: enable
mal:field.comment: Flag to enable or disable the pictures stream from the camera. If set to FALSE, all other fields are ignored and can be NULL.

mal:field.name: streamingPeriod
mal:field.comment: The streaming period of the pictures.

mal:field.name: tag
mal:field.comment: The subscription key for filtering during the picturesStream broadcast.

mal:field.name: settings
mal:field.comment: Image acquisition settings.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the Camera is currently being used. Use the enableStream(false, ...) operation to stop the streaming and try again.
When the Camera unit is not available.
When the requested streaming period is not supported.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The minimum duration that can be selected.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the requested resolution is not supported.
When the requested format is not supported.
When the tag field is NULL or a wildcard.

mal:requestIP.name: previewPicture
mal:requestIP.comment: The previewPicture operation allows a consumer to quickly get a raw picture from the camera with a lower quality. This operation is intended to provide a quick snap of what the camera is observing.

mal:field.name: picture
mal:field.comment: The picture preview.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the Camera unit is not available.

mal:invokeIP.name: takePicture
mal:invokeIP.comment: The takePicture operation allows a consumer to take a picture from the camera. The appropriate dimension and format of the picture can be selected.

mal:field.name: settings
mal:field.comment: Picture acquisition settings.

mal:field.name: picture
mal:field.comment: The acquired picture.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the Camera is currently being used. Use the enableStream(false, ...) operation to stop the streaming and try again.
When the Camera unit is not available.
When the requested resolution is not supported.
When the requested format is not supported.

mal:invokeIP.name: takeAutoExposedPicture
mal:invokeIP.comment: The takeAutoExposedPicture operation allows a consumer to take a picture from the camera. The appropriate dimension and format of the picture can be selected. The exposure will be auto calculated, but it is slower than using takePicture.

mal:field.name: settings
mal:field.comment: Picture acquisition settings.

mal:field.name: picture
mal:field.comment: The acquired picture.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the Camera is currently being used. Use the enableStream(false, ...) operation to stop the streaming and try again.
When the Camera unit is not available.
When the requested resolution is not supported.
When the requested format is not supported.

mal:requestIP.name: getProperties
mal:requestIP.comment: The getProperties operation allows a consumer to request the properties of the service and camera. The service shall provide information about the available resolutions, formats and some extra information.

mal:field.name: availableResolutions
mal:field.comment: The list of available resolutions supported by the camera.

mal:field.name: availableFormats
mal:field.comment: The list of available formats supported by the service.

mal:field.name: extraInfo
mal:field.comment: Additional properties of the camera. The actual content is undefined.

mal:invokeIP.name: preprocessPicture
mal:invokeIP.comment: The preprocessPicture operation allows a consumer to preprocess a picture.

mal:field.name: inputPicture
mal:field.comment: The input picture to be preprocessed.

mal:field.name: settings
mal:field.comment: Picture acquisition settings.

mal:field.name: outputPicture
mal:field.comment: The preprocessed picture.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the inputPicture or the settings field contains an invalid value.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The name of the first invalid field.

mal:service.name: GPS
mal:service.comment: The GPS service provides the ability to retrieve satellite navigation data from a Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) device receiver in the spacecraft platform. The GPS service provides the capability for streaming NMEA messages; the capability for enabling/disabling the streaming of NMEA messages; the capability for getting the last known position from the receiver; the capability for getting the satellites GNSS information; the capability for maintaining the list of nearby position events. The nearbyPosition operation allows a consumer to receive a message from the service when the spacecraft enters or exits a certain position. These can be set using the addNearbyPosition and removed using the removeNearbyPosition.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The GPS service shall provide:
  1. the capability for requesting GPS NMEA sentences;
  2. the capability for getting the last known position from the GPS;
  3. the capability for getting the satellites GPS information;
  4. the capability for maintaining the list of nearby position events.
The service provider shall represent position markers for nearby position events as NearbyPosition COM objects.

The source link of the NearbyPosition object should be the object that caused it to be created, most likely a COM OperationActivity object or an operator login in the case of off-line editors being used.
The service provider shall use a boolean value as the body of the NearbyPositionAlert object.
The service provider should store NearbyPosition objects in the COM archive.
Upon publishing a nearby position event, the service provider should store the NearbyPositionAlert object in the COM archive.

mal:invokeIP.name: getNMEASentence
mal:invokeIP.comment: The getNMEASentence operation allows a consumer to request a NMEA sentence from a sentence identifier.

mal:field.name: sentenceIdentifier
mal:field.comment: The sentence identifier of the request.

mal:field.name: sentence
mal:field.comment: The response NMEA sentence.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the requested sentence identifier is invalid.
When the GPS unit is not available.

mal:requestIP.name: getLastKnownPosition
mal:requestIP.comment: The getLastKnownPosition operation allows a consumer to retrieve the last known position that was provided by the GPS unit.

mal:field.name: position
mal:field.comment: The last known position.

mal:field.name: elapsedTime
mal:field.comment: The elapsed time since the position was determined.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the position is unknown.

mal:invokeIP.name: getPosition
mal:invokeIP.comment: The getPosition operation allows a consumer to obtain a position from the GPS unit.

mal:field.name: position
mal:field.comment: The current position.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the GPS unit is not available.
When the position is unknown.

mal:invokeIP.name: getSatellitesInfo
mal:invokeIP.comment: The getSatellitesInfo operation allows a consumer to obtain the satellites information from the GPS.

mal:field.name: gpsSatellitesInfo
mal:field.comment: The information of the satellites.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the GPS unit is not available.

mal:requestIP.name: listNearbyPosition
mal:requestIP.comment: The listNearbyPosition operation allows a consumer to request the identifiers of the existing nearby position events in the service. The operation is expected to be used in conjunction with the COM archive for retrieval of the actual nearby position objects.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: A consumer may supply the wildcard value of '*' in the names field to return all supported nearby position events.
The RESPONSE message shall maintain the same ordering as the REQUEST message unless the wildcard value was included in the request.

mal:field.name: names
mal:field.comment: The list of NearbyPositionEvent names.

mal:field.name: objInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of object instance identifiers corresponding to the selected names.

mal:requestIP.name: addNearbyPosition
mal:requestIP.comment: The addNearbyPosition operation allows a consumer to define a list of nearby position events in the service. The new NearbyPosition objects are expected to be stored in the COM Archive by the provider of the GPS service.

mal:field.name: nearbyPositionDefinitions
mal:field.comment: The list of nearby position definitions to add.

mal:field.name: objInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of object instance identifiers assigned to the newly created NearbyPosition objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one of the supplied NearbyPositionDefinition objects contains an invalid name.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The indexes of the erroneous entries in the nearbyPositionDefinitions list.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one or more of the nearbyPositionDefinitions entries has a name that is already in use in the domain.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The indexes of the duplicate entries in the nearbyPositionDefinitions list.

mal:submitIP.name: removeNearbyPosition
mal:submitIP.comment: The removeNearbyPosition operation allows a consumer to remove a list of nearby position events set in the service.

mal:field.name: objInstIds
mal:field.comment: The list of object instance identifiers of the NearbyPosition objects to remove.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one of the supplied NearbyPosition object instance identifiers is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The indexes of the unknown entries in the objInstIds list.

mal:pubsubIP.name: nearbyPosition
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The nearbyPosition operation allows a consumer to subscribe to nearby position notifications.
mal:pubsubIP.mal:documentation: If the GPS current position has entered the nearby position boundary, then the service provider shall set the isEntering field to TRUE.
If the GPS current position has exited the nearby position boundary, then the service provider shall set the isEntering field to FALSE.
The NOTIFY message timestamp shall be the on-board clock time at the time of the notification.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: The NearbyPosition name.

mal:field.name: objId
mal:field.comment: The NearbyPosition object instance identifier.

mal:field.name: pValObjId
mal:field.comment: The NearbyPositionAlert object instance identifier.

mal:field.name: isEntering
mal:field.comment: TRUE if the spacecraft has entered the nearby position boundary; FALSE if it has exited.

mal:invokeIP.name: getBestXYZSentence
mal:invokeIP.comment: The getBestXYZSentence operation allows a consumer to request a GNSS BestXYZ sentence returning cartesian x-, y- and z-coordinates of the satellite.

mal:field.name: sentence
mal:field.comment: The response BestXYZ sentence.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the GPS unit is not available.

mal:invokeIP.name: getTIMEASentence
mal:invokeIP.comment: The getTIMEASentence operation allows a consumer to request a GNSS TIMEA sentence returning information on UTC time of the satellite.

mal:field.name: sentence
mal:field.comment: The response TIMEA sentence.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the GPS unit is not available.

mal:requestIP.name: getLastKnownPositionAndVelocity
mal:requestIP.comment: The getLastKnownPositionAndVelocity operation allows a consumer to retrieve the last known Position and Velocity in Cartesian coordinates, and the corresponding standard deviations that were provided by the GPS unit.

mal:field.name: position
mal:field.comment: The last known position.

mal:field.name: positionDeviation
mal:field.comment: The last known standard deviations of the position.

mal:field.name: velocity
mal:field.comment: The last known velocity.

mal:field.name: velocityDeviation
mal:field.comment: The last known standard deviations of the velocity.

mal:field.name: elapsedTime
mal:field.comment: The elapsed time since the position's determination.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the position and velocity are unknown.

mal:invokeIP.name: getPositionAndVelocity
mal:invokeIP.comment: The getPositionAndVelocity operation allows a consumer to obtain a position and velocity from the GPS unit.

mal:field.name: position
mal:field.comment: The current position.

mal:field.name: positionDeviation
mal:field.comment: The current standard deviations of the position.

mal:field.name: velocity
mal:field.comment: The current velocity.

mal:field.name: velocityDeviation
mal:field.comment: The current standard deviations of the velocity.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the GPS unit is not available.
When the position and velocity are unknown.

mal:invokeIP.name: getTLE
mal:invokeIP.comment: The getTLE operation allows a consumer to obtain the current TLE.

mal:field.name: tle
mal:field.comment: The current TLE.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the GPS unit is not available.
When the TLE is unknown.

com:sourceObject.comment: The object that caused it to be created.

com:object.name: NearbyPositionAlert
com:object.comment: Contains a boolean value indicating entering or exiting state.

com:archiveUsage.comment: NearbyPosition objects and NearbyPositionAlert objects are stored in the COM archive.

mal:service.name: AutonomousADCS
mal:service.comment: The AutonomousADCS service allows a consumer to monitor the attitude from an ADCS device in the spacecraft platform and to engage and disengage a desired attitude control mode.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The Autonomous ADCS service shall provide:
  1. the capability for periodic monitoring of the spacecraft's attitude;
  2. the capability for setting and unsetting the spacecraft's desired attitude;

mal:pubsubIP.name: monitorAttitude
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The monitorAttitude operation allows a consumer to subscribe for the spacecraft attitude, ADCS actuators status, and ADCS attitude control mode status.
mal:pubsubIP.mal:documentation: A consumer shall set the ObjectKey to NULL when subscribing.

mal:field.name: attitudeTelemetry
mal:field.comment: Determined spacecraft attitude.

mal:field.name: actuatorsTelemetry
mal:field.comment: Status of the ADCS actuators.

mal:field.name: controlDuration
mal:field.comment: The remaining duration of the active attitude control mode. NULL if no time duration is set, or no attitude control is active.

mal:field.name: activeAttitudeMode
mal:field.comment: Active attitude mode. NULL if no attitude control is active. This is an abstract type.

mal:submitIP.name: enableMonitoring
mal:submitIP.comment: The enableMonitoring operation allows a consumer to enable attitude, actuator and mode telemetry updates published through the monitorAttitude operation.

mal:field.name: enableGeneration
mal:field.comment: Flag enabling attitude status generation.

mal:field.name: monitoringInterval
mal:field.comment: Period of the monitoring messages.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the monitoringInterval field is too short or was not provided.

mal:requestIP.name: getStatus
mal:requestIP.comment: The getStatus operation allows a consumer to request a single dataset of the current spacecraft attitude, ADCS actuators status, attitude control mode, and monitoring settings.

mal:field.name: attitudeTelemetry
mal:field.comment: Determined spacecraft attitude.

mal:field.name: actuatorsTelemetry
mal:field.comment: Status of the ADCS actuators.

mal:field.name: controlDuration
mal:field.comment: The remaining duration of the active attitude control mode. NULL if no time duration is set, or no attitude control is active.

mal:field.name: generationEnabled
mal:field.comment: Indicates whether ADCS status is published periodically through monitorAttitude operation.

mal:field.name: monitoringInterval
mal:field.comment: Period of the monitoring messages.

mal:field.name: activeAttitudeMode
mal:field.comment: Active attitude mode. NULL if no attitude control is active. This is an abstract type.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS unit is not available.

mal:submitIP.name: setDesiredAttitude
mal:submitIP.comment: The setDesiredAttitude operation allows a consumer to engage or disengage a certain attitude mode using an attitude mode.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: If the duration field is NULL, then the service provider shall not automatically disengage the attitude setting.
If the duration field is NULL, then a consumer should use the setDesiredAttitude operation again to disengage the attitude setting.

mal:field.name: duration
mal:field.comment: The duration after which the attitude mode is automatically disengaged.

mal:field.name: desiredAttitude
mal:field.comment: Desired attitude mode. If set to NULL, ADCS will switch into a free tumbling mode. This is an abstract type.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS unit is not available.
When the desiredAttitude field contains an invalid argument.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The name of the first field in the attitude mode that failed validation.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS is currently being used by another attitude control mode.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The remaining duration of the active attitude control mode, or NULL if the active mode has no time limit.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the selected attitude mode is not supported by the current implementation.

mal:submitIP.name: setReactionWheelSpeed
mal:submitIP.comment: The setReactionWheelSpeed operation allows a consumer to set a desired speed for the specified Reaction wheel in rad/second.

mal:field.name: wheel
mal:field.comment: The Reaction wheel indentifier.

mal:field.name: speed
mal:field.comment: Desired Speed in rad/second.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS unit is not available.

mal:submitIP.name: setAllReactionWheelSpeeds
mal:submitIP.comment: The setAllReactionWheelSpeeds operation allows a consumer to set the desired speed for all Reaction wheels in rad/second.

mal:field.name: speedX
mal:field.comment: Desired Speed of wheel x in rad/second.

mal:field.name: speedY
mal:field.comment: Desired Speed of wheel y in rad/second.

mal:field.name: speedZ
mal:field.comment: Desired Speed of wheel z in rad/second.

mal:field.name: speedU
mal:field.comment: Desired Speed of wheel u in rad/second.

mal:field.name: speedV
mal:field.comment: Desired Speed of wheel v in rad/second.

mal:field.name: speedW
mal:field.comment: Desired Speed of wheel w in rad/second.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS unit is not available.

mal:submitIP.name: setAllReactionWheelParameters
mal:submitIP.comment: The setAllReactionWheelParameters operation allows a consumer to set the desired parameters for all Reaction wheels. All parameters that are set to -1 will not be changed. Note: This will affect all ADCS operation modes; only maximum speed, maximum torque and control mode will be changed.

mal:field.name: parameters
mal:field.comment: Reaction wheel parameters.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS unit is not available.

mal:submitIP.name: setAllMagnetorquersDipoleMoments
mal:submitIP.comment: The setAllMagnetorquersDipoleMoments operation allows a consumer to set the desired dipole moments for all Magnetorquers in Am.

mal:field.name: dipoleX
mal:field.comment: Desired Dipole moment for Magnetorquer x in Am (in actuator frame).

mal:field.name: dipoleY
mal:field.comment: Desired Dipole moment for Magnetorquer y in Am (in actuator frame).

mal:field.name: dipoleZ
mal:field.comment: Desired Dipole moment for Magnetorquer z in Am (in actuator frame).

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS unit is not available.

mal:requestIP.name: getAllReactionWheelParameters
mal:requestIP.comment: The getAllReactionWheelParameters operation allows a consumer to get all parameters that are currently set for the Reaction wheels.

mal:field.name: parameters
mal:field.comment: Reaction wheel parameters.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the ADCS unit is not available.

mal:service.name: SoftwareDefinedRadio
mal:service.comment: The Software-defined Radio provides a generic mechanism to set, configure and receive data from a Software-defined Radio device.

mal:pubsubIP.name: streamRadio
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The streamRadio operation allows a consumer to subscribe for Software-defined Radio data updates.

mal:field.name: iqComponents
mal:field.comment: The in-phase and quadrature data from the Software-defined Radio unit.

mal:submitIP.name: enableSDR
mal:submitIP.comment: The enableSDR operation allows a consumer to enable or disable the Software-defined Radio.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: If the enable field is TRUE, then the service provider shall enable the Software-defined Radio.
If the enable field is FALSE, then the service provider shall disable the Software-defined Radio.

mal:field.name: enable
mal:field.comment: The flag status to enable or disable the Software-defined Radio.

mal:field.name: initialConfiguration
mal:field.comment: The configuration to be set right after the SDR is enabled.

mal:field.name: publishingPeriod
mal:field.comment: The period at which the SDR publishes data through the streamRadio operation.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the initialConfiguration field contains an invalid value.
When the Software-defined Radio could not be enabled.

mal:submitIP.name: updateConfiguration
mal:submitIP.comment: The updateConfiguration operation allows a consumer to set a configuration on the Software-defined Radio.

mal:field.name: configuration
mal:field.comment: The configuration of the SDR.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the configuration field contains an invalid value.

mal:service.name: OpticalDataReceiver
mal:service.comment: The Optical Data Receiver service provides a mechanism to receive messages from an Optical Data Receiver device.

mal:invokeIP.name: recordSamples
mal:invokeIP.comment: The recordSamples operation allows a consumer to record a sample.

mal:field.name: recordingDuration
mal:field.comment: The duration of samples acquisition.

mal:field.name: data
mal:field.comment: A blob of data from the Optical Data Receiver. Sample buffer format is implementation specific.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the recordingDuration field exceeds the maximum allowed recording duration.

mal:service.name: PowerControl
mal:service.comment: The Power Control service provides a generic mechanism to list the available power units in a spacecraft platform and to enable/disable them.

mal:requestIP.name: listDevices
mal:requestIP.comment: The listDevices operation allows a consumer to request the list of the units available and their respective status. The request may contain the wildcard value of '*' to return all available devices.

mal:field.name: names
mal:field.comment: The name of the units.

mal:field.name: devices
mal:field.comment: List of returned devices.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one of the supplied identifiers in the names list is unknown.

mal:extraInformation.comment: The indexes of the unknown entries in the names list.

mal:requestIP.name: enableDevices
mal:requestIP.comment: The enableDevices operation allows a consumer to enable and disable specific devices. Device can be identified by object instance identifier and/or unit Type. If object instance identifier is NULL, then the first device of given type is selected.

mal:field.name: devices
mal:field.comment: List of devices to be controlled.

mal:errorRef.comment: When at least one of the devices requested is not available for power control.

mal:service.name: Clock
mal:service.comment: The Clock service provides system time.

mal:requestIP.name: getTime
mal:requestIP.comment: The getTime operation allows a consumer to request current system time in milliseconds.

mal:field.name: time
mal:field.comment: Current time in milliseconds.

mal:requestIP.name: getTimeFactor
mal:requestIP.comment: The getTimeFactor operation allows a consumer to request time factor of the simulation.

mal:field.name: timeFactor
mal:field.comment: Current time factor of the simulation.

mal:pubsubIP.name: monitorTimeFactor
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The monitorTimeFactor operation allows a consumer to subscribe for time factor changes.

mal:field.name: timeFactor
mal:field.comment: The current time factor of the simulation.

mal:service.name: ArtificialIntelligence
mal:service.comment: The Artificial Intelligence service provides a generic mechanism to control a AI device including setting the models and control the inference of images.

mal:requestIP.name: setModel
mal:requestIP.comment: The setModel operation allows a consumer to set the Model to be used by the AI device.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: If there is also an associated weights file, then its path and filename shall be the same as the model with the only difference being the file extension (from .xml to .bin).

mal:field.name: modelPath
mal:field.comment: The absolute path to the model file.

mal:field.name: modelId
mal:field.comment: The id of the model.

mal:requestIP.name: doInference
mal:requestIP.comment: The doInference operation allows a consumer to perform inference on the AI device.

mal:field.name: modelId
mal:field.comment: The id of the model to be used for inference.

mal:field.name: inputTilesPath
mal:field.comment: The absolute path to a folder with the tiles to be processed.

mal:field.name: outputTilesPath
mal:field.comment: The absolute path to a folder with the inferred tiles.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the inputTilesPath field does not refer to an existing folder.

mal:invokeIP.name: doComputerVision
mal:invokeIP.comment: The doComputerVision operation allows a consumer to invoke the execution of inference with an AI unit.

mal:field.name: jsonPath
mal:field.comment: The absolute path to a json file with information to be processed.

mal:field.name: success
mal:field.comment: TRUE if the execution of the computer vision was successful; FALSE otherwise.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the execution could not be completed successfully.
When the AI device is not available.
When the AI device is currently being used.

mal:composite.name: PositionExtraDetails
mal:composite.comment: Extra position information that can be provided by a GPS unit.

mal:field.name: utc
mal:field.comment: UTC time status of position.

mal:field.name: fixQuality
numberOfSatellites
mal:field.comment: The number of satellites in view for this position.

mal:field.name: hdop
mal:field.comment: Horizontal Dilution of Precision. The relative accuracy of horizontal position.

mal:field.name: undulation
mal:field.comment: The relationship between the geoid and the WGS84 ellipsoid. The unit is meters.

mal:field.name: positionSource
mal:field.comment: Source of the position data (e.g. directly from GNSS or propagated via TLE).

mal:composite.name: NearbyPositionDefinition
mal:composite.comment: A definition of a nearby position.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: The name of the definition.

mal:field.name: description
mal:field.comment: A textual description of the definition.

mal:field.name: distanceBoundary
mal:field.comment: The distance boundary of this definition. The distance boundary shall define a spherical zone around the position. The unit is meters.

mal:field.name: position
mal:field.comment: The position of the definition.

mal:composite.name: TwoLineElementSet
mal:composite.comment: The two-line element set reported by the GPS unit.

mal:field.name: catalogNo
mal:field.comment: The Satellite catalog number.

mal:field.name: classification
mal:field.comment: The Classification. Possible Values: U=Unclassified, C=Classified, S=Secret.

mal:field.name: idYear
mal:field.comment: First part of International Designator, containing the last two digits of the launch year.

mal:field.name: idLaunchNo
mal:field.comment: Second part of International Designator, containing launch number of the year.

mal:field.name: idPiece
mal:field.comment: Third part of International Designator, containing the piece of launch.

mal:field.name: epochYear
mal:field.comment: Epoch year (last two digits of year).

mal:field.name: epochDay
mal:field.comment: Epoch day (day of year).

mal:field.name: epochSecond
mal:field.comment: Epoch second (Second of day).

mal:field.name: meanMotionD1
mal:field.comment: First Derivative of Mean Motion.

mal:field.name: meanMotionD2
mal:field.comment: Second Derivative of Mean Motion.

mal:field.name: dragTerm
mal:field.comment: Drag Term (Radiation Pressure Coefficient).

mal:field.name: id
mal:field.comment: Element set number (ID of this set).

mal:field.name: inclination
mal:field.comment: The Inclination. The unit is in decimal degrees.

mal:field.name: raan
mal:field.comment: The right ascension of the ascending node. The unit is in decimal degrees.

mal:field.name: eccentricity
mal:field.comment: The eccentricity. The unit is in decimal degrees.

mal:field.name: argumentOfPerigee
mal:field.comment: The argument of perigee. The unit is in decimal degrees.

mal:field.name: meanAnomaly
mal:field.comment: The mean anomaly. The unit is in decimal degrees.

mal:field.name: meanMotion
mal:field.comment: The mean motion. The unit is revolutions per daz.

mal:field.name: numRevolutions
mal:field.comment: The number of completed revolutions at epoch.

mal:composite.name: Quaternion
mal:composite.comment: Quaternion components.

mal:field.name: a
mal:field.comment: Quaternion scalar component a.

mal:field.name: b
mal:field.comment: Quaternion vector component b*i.

mal:field.name: c
mal:field.comment: Quaternion vector component c*j.

mal:field.name: d
mal:field.comment: Quaternion vector component d*k.

mal:composite.name: AttitudeMode
mal:composite.comment: An abstract attitude setting defined by the consumer. This composite is specialized into particular attitude mode descriptors.

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeBDot
mal:composite.comment: B-dot detumbling attitude mode defined by the consumer.

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeSingleSpinning
mal:composite.comment: Single-axis spinning attitude mode defined by the consumer.

mal:field.name: bodyAxis
mal:field.comment: The spin axis vector, defined in the body reference frame.

mal:field.name: angularVelocity
mal:field.comment: The angular velocity of the spin. The right-hand rule shall be followed to indicate the positive direction of the angular velocity. [rad/s].

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeSunPointing
mal:composite.comment: Sun Pointing attitude mode defined by the consumer.

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeTargetTracking
mal:composite.comment: Fixed Ground Target Tracking attitude mode defined by the consumer.

mal:field.name: latitude
mal:field.comment: The latitude of the target to be tracked. [deg].

mal:field.name: longitude
mal:field.comment: The longitude of the target to be tracked. [deg].

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeTargetTrackingLinear
mal:composite.comment: Constant velocity Ground Target Tracking attitude mode defined by the consumer.

mal:field.name: latitudeStart
mal:field.comment: The start latitude of the target to be tracked. [deg].

mal:field.name: longitudeStart
mal:field.comment: The start longitude of the target to be tracked. [deg].

mal:field.name: latitudeEnd
mal:field.comment: The end latitude of the target to be tracked. [deg].

mal:field.name: longitudeEnd
mal:field.comment: The end longitude of the target to be tracked. [deg].

mal:field.name: startEpoch
mal:field.comment: The beginning epoch time of the tracking. [msec].

mal:field.name: endEpoch
mal:field.comment: The ending epoch time of the tracking. [msec].

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeNadirPointing
mal:composite.comment: Nadir Pointing attitude mode defined by the consumer.

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeVectorPointing
mal:composite.comment: Vector Pointing attitude mode defined by the consumer.

mal:field.name: target
mal:field.comment: Vector the Satelite should point the camera at (in ICRF).

mal:field.name: margin
mal:field.comment: margin between target vector and current vector (in degrees).

mal:composite.name: AttitudeModeInertialPointing
mal:composite.comment: Inertial Pointing attitude mode.

mal:field.name: targetVector
mal:field.comment: Line of sight vector in satellite body frame pointing to the target.

mal:field.name: flightVector
mal:field.comment: Flight vector in satellite body frame pointing into the flight direction.

mal:field.name: targetAttitude
mal:field.comment: Target attitude quaternion in ECI frame.

mal:composite.name: WheelsSpeed
mal:composite.comment: The speeds of the reaction wheels.

mal:field.name: rotationalSpeed
mal:field.comment: Angular velocities of the wheels. The ordering of the array is implementation specific (typically X,Y,Z[,U,V,W]). [rad/sec].

mal:composite.name: ActuatorsTelemetry
mal:composite.comment: The ADCS actuators telemetry.

mal:field.name: targetWheelSpeed
mal:field.comment: Target reaction wheels speed.

mal:field.name: currentWheelSpeed
mal:field.comment: Current reaction wheels speed.

mal:field.name: mtqDipoleMoment
mal:field.comment: Target magnetorquers dipole moment relative to the spacecraft frame. [A*m^2].

mal:field.name: mtqState
mal:field.comment: Current state of the magnetorquers.

mal:composite.name: AttitudeTelemetry
mal:composite.comment: The derived ADCS telemetry.

mal:field.name: attitude
mal:field.comment: Calculated attitude quaternion of the spacecraft frame relative to International Celestial Reference Frame (ICRF).

mal:field.name: angularVelocity
mal:field.comment: Calculated angular velocity vector (x,y,z) relative to the spacecraft frame. [rad/sec].

mal:field.name: sunVector
mal:field.comment: Calculated dimensionless sun vector (x,y,z) relative to the spacecraft frame.

mal:field.name: magneticField
mal:field.comment: Calculated magnetic flux density relative to the spacecraft frame. [T].

mal:field.name: stateTarget
mal:field.comment: TRUE if the desired pointing mode is achieved; FALSE otherwise.

mal:composite.name: ReactionWheelParameters
mal:composite.comment: Reaction wheel parameters.

mal:field.name: controlMode
mal:field.comment: Control mode of the Reaction wheels. 0 = Target value is a current value [A]; 1 = Target value is a speed value [rad/sec]; 2 = Target alue is a torgh [Nm].

mal:field.name: maxSpeed
mal:field.comment: maximum speed of the Reaction wheels in rad/second. For safety reasons, the value for this can not exceed 1047.197551.

mal:field.name: maxTorque
mal:field.comment: maximum torque of the Reaction wheels in Nm.

mal:field.name: inertia
mal:field.comment: moment of inertia of the Reaction wheels in kg/m^2.

mal:field.name: motorConst
mal:field.comment: motor constant of the Reaction wheels in Nm/A.

mal:composite.name: SDRConfiguration
mal:composite.comment: A configuration for the SDR. Allowed value ranges depend on the unit.

mal:field.name: rxCarrierFrequency
mal:field.comment: RX Carrier Frequency [MHz].

mal:field.name: rxGain
mal:field.comment: RX chain gain [dB].

mal:field.name: rxLowPassBW
mal:field.comment: RX Low Pass Filter bandwidth [MHz].

mal:field.name: rxSamplingFrequency
mal:field.comment: RX sampling frequency [MHz].

mal:composite.name: IQComponents
mal:composite.comment: The In-phase and Quadrature components.

mal:field.name: inPhase
mal:field.comment: The in-phase component.

mal:field.name: quadrature
mal:field.comment: The quadrature component.

mal:composite.name: Device
mal:composite.comment: A unit managed by the Power Control service.

mal:field.name: enabled
mal:field.comment: Power state of the unit.

mal:field.name: unitObjInstId
mal:field.comment: The unique object instance identifier of the device.

mal:field.name: name
mal:field.comment: Device name.

mal:field.name: deviceType
mal:field.comment: Device type.

mal:error.name: DEVICE_IN_USE
mal:error.comment: The device is currently in use.

mal:error.name: DEVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE
mal:error.comment: The device is currently not available.
